note: Simulated call with the live agent, voiced with ElevenLabs text to speech.

captions.text: Hi, this is Nobikos. Ask me what I can do for your team.
Nobikos keeps the human why behind a team's work, and who it lives with. When it is missing, it goes and asks the right person. Want to hear what that looks like?
Where does it get its knowledge from?

Nobikos learns from the work itself, documents and code changes with who owns them, and the moments people decide or explain why in AI sessions like Claude or ChatGPT. It also reaches out when something is not recorded yet, and the person's reply becomes the next answer for everyone. Want to know more about how it stays current?
And what if the answer is not in there?

If nobody has recorded it yet, Nobikos messages the person most likely to know, and their reply becomes the next answer for everyone. So the knowledge gets captured the first time someone explains it, and then it is there for the whole team.
Can I call you before a meeting to get briefed?

That is on the roadmap. Right now you can ask me by voice like this call, and I can tell you what Nobikos knows. Once it is connected to your data, you could call before a meeting to hear what was decided and who to ask. Does that help?
You're welcome. Good luck with your team!
